scope: Feedback automation evaluation and full-cycle failures

behavior.failure_response: Raw exception details are replaced with bounded operation and exception-class summaries.
behavior.failure_record: The same safe summary is stored in feedback_automation_log.errors.
behavior.lifecycle: Rollback, failed log status, commit, and cursor cleanup remain intact.

coverage: evaluation query failures do not expose database details
full-cycle application failures do not expose decision payload details
persisted error values match the bounded responses
failure rollback, failed status persistence, and cursor cleanup are retained

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked connection and signal application

limitations: No feedback automation or PostgreSQL service was started.
